sourcePolicy: Customer-specific facts belong in Workspace Context, Context Hub artifacts, user input, or approved connected sources.
Reusable agent packages must not embed customer-specific business context.
Unknown facts must be requested or marked TBD.
Risky claims about pricing, privacy, security, compliance, retention, guarantees, live execution, or performance require approved evidence.

agents.description: Bootstraps a clean Marketing OS workspace by drafting Context Hub artifacts, a concise Workspace Context update, approval checkpoints, and next-agent routing.

contextHub.missingContextBehavior: Ask for critical missing business context when blocked; otherwise draft with TBD markers.

agents.description: Drafts newsletter issues from approved messaging, audience context, proof constraints, and channel rules.

contextHub.missingContextBehavior: Ask for audience, theme, and proof gaps before drafting claims.

agents.description: Drafts social content using approved messaging, brand direction, channel constraints, and proof policy.

contextHub.missingContextBehavior: Draft platform-safe options and mark unapproved claims TBD.

agents.description: Creates event briefs, titles, abstracts, speaker needs, and approval packets from approved GTM context.

contextHub.missingContextBehavior: Ask for date, audience, speakers, and claims when needed.

agents.description: Builds event promotion plans and copy across approved channels.

contextHub.missingContextBehavior: Ask for event details and suppressions before recommending sends or posts.

agents.description: Turns approved audience context into reviewable segment logic and suppression rules.

contextHub.missingContextBehavior: Request source data and consent constraints before producing usable segment logic.

agents.description: Drafts owned media assets from approved messaging, brand direction, channel registry, and proof policy.

contextHub.missingContextBehavior: Ask for asset purpose, audience, and evidence gaps before final copy.

agents.description: Drafts campaign and paid media plans that stay behind approval and evidence gates.
